skills.grammarMd:
Verbs that take no object (go, come, sit, sleep…) make their past from the **past stem** with the personal endings:

| | çûn (go) | hatin (come) |
|---|---|---|
| ez | çûm | hatim |
| tu | çûyî | hatî |
| ew | çû | hat |
| em, hûn, ew | çûn | hatin |

The past stem is the dictionary form without **-n**: *çûn → çû*, *rabûn → rabû*, *ketin → ket*, *mayîn → ma*.

**Not** is **ne-** in front: *Ez neçûm.* I didn’t go. · *Ew nehat.* He didn’t come.

*Duh çi bû?* What happened yesterday? · *Ez duh çûm bazarê.* I went to the market yesterday.

skills.grammarMd:
Words that put a story in the past:

- *duh* yesterday · *pêr* the day before yesterday · *par* last year · *berê* before, in the old days
- *hefteya borî* last week · *sala borî* last year · *wê demê* at that time
- *sê roj berî niha* three days ago · *bîst sal berî niha* twenty years ago

**dema ku** (or just **dema**) joins two things that happened at the same time: *Dema ku ez zarok bûm, em li zozanan bûn.* When I was a child, we were on the summer pastures.

**hebû** is the past of *heye*: *Gurek hebû.* There was a wolf. · *Hespekî me hebû.* We had a horse.

skills.grammarMd:
Every Kurdish tale starts in the past with **hebû** — *Hebû tunebû…* Once upon a time (there was, there wasn’t).

- *Kerekî me hebû.* We had a donkey.
- *Li gund dibistan tunebû.* There was no school in the village.

Chain the events with **û** and **paşê**: *Ez rabûm, derketim û ber bi çiyê ve meşiyam.* I got up, went out and walked towards the mountain.

The negative past puts **ne-** before the verb: *Bozo nehat.* Bozo didn’t come. · *Em neçûn.* We didn’t go. · *Ew dereng nema.* She didn’t stay late.

With a compound verb the ne- goes on the verb part: *Ez siwar nebûm.* I didn’t ride.

lines.en: Wait! Look, by the spring!

lines.text: Bozo li wir e… û kera Ferhad jî bi wî re ye!

lines.text: Li çavên wî binêre! Bozo evîndar e.
lines.en: Look at his eyes! Bozo is in love.

lines.text: Evîn! Lê kera Ferhad şermok e, ew li erdê dinêre.
lines.en: Love! But Ferhad’s donkey is shy, she’s looking at the ground.

lines.text: Wek Nazê, berî sî salan!
lines.en: Like Nazê, thirty years ago!

lines.text: Xalo! Ez ê vê ji Nazê re bibêjim!
lines.en: Uncle! I’m telling Nazê you said that!

lines.text: Dapîr dibêje ku dema ew keçik bû, ew bi diya xwe re çû zozanan.
lines.en: Grandma says that when she was a girl, she went to the pastures with her mother.

lines.text: Erê. Li wir dawet hebûn, û xort û keçik tevlî govendê bûn.
lines.en: Yes. There were weddings there, and the young men and girls joined the dance.

lines.text: Û bapîr? Ew jî li wir bû?
lines.en: And Grandpa? Was he there too?

lines.text: Ew xortekî ciwan bû. Lê ev çîrokeke din e…
lines.en: He was a handsome young man. But that’s another story…

lines.text: Xalo! Bibêje!
lines.en: Uncle! Tell me!

lines.text: Paşê. Berbang e, em diçin!
lines.en: Later. It’s dawn, we’re off!

lines.text: Binêre, li ser rê gelek pez hene!
lines.en: Look, there are lots of sheep on the path!

lines.text: Û şivanek li dû wan tê. Ez wî nas dikim!
